items.title: Tyler Huntley: Could land on IR
items.text:
Ravens head coach Jesse Minter said Tuesday that Huntley (toe) could be a candidate for injured reserve, Sam Cohn of The Baltimore Sunreports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Jeremiyah Love: Bound for IR with high-ankle sprain
items.text:
Love was diagnosed Tuesday with a right high-ankle sprain, which is expected to send him to injured reserve and keep him out for 4-to-5 weeks, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Joe Fagnano: Practicing with 'significant' brace
items.text:

items.title: Jeremiyah Love: Hits IR, out 4-to-5 weeks
items.text:
